title: A Rapid Assessment Technique for Identifying Future Water Use and Pesticide Risks Due to Changing Cropping Patterns
abstract: Changing weather patterns have already put pressure on cropping systems around the globe. Projected increases in mean temperatures and variance in precipitation will likely affect the profitability of current cropping patterns, leading to shifts in which crops are grown in a given location. The pressure on water resources in a location, in terms of both water quantity and water quality, will also change with the types of crops grown. While the southeastern United States is projected to become warmer under each of the representative concentration pathways, it is also projected to become somewhat wetter. California’s Central Valley, where much of the fresh produce in the US is grown, will likely continue to suffer significant and extended droughts. The southeastern US is a prime candidate for expanding fresh produce production in response to reduced yields in the west. This paper explores the consequences on water withdrawals and water quality of shifting from row crop to vegetable production in the southeastern US. The water quality consequences are based on changes in pesticide products and application rates. The water quantity consequences are based on crop water needs. The methodology used here can be applied to other production systems around the world. Identifying the water quality and quantity implications of shifting cropping patterns is critical to the long-term sustainability of water resources.
abstract_zh: 气候模式的变化已经对全球各地的种植体系造成压力。预计平均气温的上升和降水变异性的增加，将影响当前种植模式的盈利能力，并导致某一地区种植作物类型的转变。一个地区的水资源压力，无论是在水量还是水质方面，也会随所种作物类型的变化而改变。尽管美国东南部在各个典型浓度路径（RCP）情景下都预计将变暖，但其降水也可能有所增加。加利福尼亚中央谷地是美国大部分新鲜农产品的产地，该地区很可能将继续遭受严重且持续的干旱。美国东南部是新鲜农产品扩大生产的理想候选地区，以应对西部产量的下降。本文探讨了美国东南部由大田作物转向蔬菜生产，对取水量和水质产生的后果。水质后果基于农药产品及施用量的变化。水量后果基于作物的需水量。这里采用的方法可以应用于世界其他地区的生产体系。识别种植模式转变对水质和水量的影响，对水资源的长期可持续性至关重要。

title: Cost-Effectiveness of Sustainable Agricultural Water Policies: Source Switching versus Irrigation Buyout Auctions in Georgia's Lower Flint River Basin
abstract: In this paper, a new methodology for comparing the cost-effectiveness of sustainable agricultural water policies during times of drought is developed. The methodology explicitly accounts for regional economic impacts from policy implementation and uncertainty related to drought frequency. The methodology is applied to two policy options being considered by the state of Georgia in the lower Flint River basin: irrigation buyout auctions and source switching. The results demonstrate the following: (1) the importance of modeling uncertainty associated with both the frequency and timing of drought, and the hydrologic effects of source switching; (2) as the frequency of drought increases, the cost-effectiveness of irrigation buyout auctions decreases. Failure to incorporate the regional economic impacts of each policy significantly underestimates the costs of both, but more so for irrigation buyout auctions than source switching. The ability to proactively manage the uncertainty associated with source switching through research and the judicious site selection of new irrigation wells increases its cost-effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的方法，用于比较干旱时期可持续农业水资源政策的成本效益。该方法明确考虑了政策实施所带来的区域经济影响，以及与干旱频率相关的不确定性。该方法应用于佐治亚州正在考虑的两项政策选项，研究地点为其下弗林特河流域：灌溉权回购拍卖与水源转换。结果表明：（1）对干旱的频率和发生时间的不确定性，以及水源转换的水文效应进行建模十分重要；（2）随着干旱频率的增加，灌溉权回购拍卖的成本效益下降。若未纳入各政策的区域经济影响，会显著低估两者的成本，且对灌溉权回购拍卖的低估程度高于水源转换。通过研究和审慎选择新灌溉水井的位置来主动管理水源转换中的不确定性，可以提高其成本效益。

title: Designing Watersheds for Integrated Development (DWID): A stochastic dynamic optimization approach for understanding expected land use changes to meet potential water quality regulations
Effects of state and federal policy on renewable electricity generation capacity in the United States
abstract: Multiple studies have examined the impact of state-level renewable portfolio standards (RPS) on renewable electricity generating capacity. Two of the most widely cited of these papers (Yin and Powers, 2010; Shrimali et al., 2015) both conclude that as an RPS mandates higher shares of renewable generating capacity within a state, utilities respond by increasing the renewable electricity generating capacity. When we update the data for those models, we find that conclusion is not robust. We also modify those models and extend the datasets out to 2018, and in every model-permutation fail to corroborate the original conclusions. Finally, we examine the impact of the 2009 American Reinvestment and Recovery Act, and find it has had a significant, positive impact on renewable electricity generating capacity. We conclude that state-level RPS are not a sufficient substitute for federal action to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the electricity sector. Federal leadership matters. This paper also demonstrates the importance of investigating the robustness of previous results to data refinements.
abstract_zh: 已有多项研究考察了州级可再生能源配额制（RPS）对可再生电力装机容量的影响。其中两篇被引用最广的论文（Yin和Powers，2010；Shrimali等，2015）均得出结论：当RPS要求一州提高可再生发电容量的比例时，公用事业公司会相应增加可再生电力装机容量。当我们更新这些模型的数据时，发现该结论并不稳健。我们还修改了这些模型，并将数据集延伸至2018年，在每一种模型设定组合中，均未能证实原有结论。最后，我们考察了2009年《美国复苏与再投资法案》的影响，发现其对可再生电力装机容量产生了显著的正向影响。我们的结论是，州级RPS不足以替代联邦层面减少电力部门温室气体排放的行动。联邦的领导作用至关重要。本文还表明，检验既有结果对数据修正的稳健性十分重要。

title: A framework for localizing global climate solutions and their carbon reduction potential
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Only 22 states in the United States have climate action plans, and of these, only six consider carbon mitigation, negative emissions, and equity issues. In the absence of robust federal or state policy action, there is a need for subnational carbon abatement planning. However, many of the most robust frameworks for carbon abatement are at a global or national scale. We provide a framework for localizing an existing global roadmap of climate solutions for Georgia, a state located in the southeastern United States. We thereby provide a replicable model that documents how subnational actors can evaluate high-potential emission reduction and carbon removal solutions while considering systems of solutions and taking into account social, ecological, and technological issues and priorities.
abstract_zh: 美国仅有22个州制定了气候行动计划，其中只有6个州考虑了碳减排、负排放以及公平问题。在缺乏有力的联邦或州级政策行动的情况下，有必要开展次国家层面的碳减排规划。然而，许多最为完善的碳减排框架都是在全球或国家尺度上制定的。我们提供了一个框架，用以将现有的全球气候解决方案路线图本地化，并应用于位于美国东南部的佐治亚州。由此，我们提供了一个可复制的模型，记录了次国家层面的行动者如何评估高潜力的减排与碳移除方案，同时兼顾各类方案组合，并考虑社会、生态和技术方面的问题与优先事项。

title: Translating a Global Emission-Reduction Framework for Subnational Climate Action: A Case Study from the State of Georgia
abstract: Subnational entities are recognizing the need to systematically examine options for reducing their carbon footprints. However, few robust and comprehensive analyses are available that lay out how US states and regions can most effectively contribute. This paper describes an approach developed for Georgia—a state in the southeastern United States called “Drawdown Georgia”, our research involves (1) understanding Georgia’s baseline carbon footprint and trends, (2) identifying the universe of Georgia-specific carbon-reduction solutions that could be impactful by 2030, (3) estimating the greenhouse gas reduction potential of these high-impact 2030 solutions for Georgia, and (4) estimating associated costs and benefits while also considering how the solutions might impact societal priorities, such as economic development opportunities, public health, environmental benefits, and equity. We began by examining the global solutions identified by Project Drawdown. The resulting 20 high-impact 2030 solutions provide a strategy for reducing Georgia’s carbon footprint in the next decade using market-ready technologies and practices and including negative emission solutions. This paper describes our systematic and replicable process and ends with a discussion of its strengths, weaknesses, and planned future research.
abstract_zh: 次国家层面的实体正逐渐认识到，有必要系统地考察减少其碳足迹的各种选择。然而，目前很少有稳健且全面的分析，能够说明美国各州和地区如何才能最有效地做出贡献。本文描述了为佐治亚州（美国东南部的一个州）开发的一种方法，即“佐治亚减碳计划”（Drawdown Georgia）。我们的研究包括：（1）了解佐治亚州的碳足迹基线及其趋势；（2）识别到2030年可能产生重大影响的、适用于佐治亚州的全部碳减排方案；（3）估算这些具有高影响力的2030年方案对佐治亚州温室气体的减排潜力；以及（4）估算其相关成本与效益，同时考虑这些方案可能如何影响社会优先事项，例如经济发展机会、公共健康、环境效益和公平。我们从“全球减碳计划”（Project Drawdown）所识别的全球解决方案入手。由此得到的20项具有高影响力的2030年解决方案，为佐治亚州在未来十年内减少碳足迹提供了战略，这些方案利用的是已具备市场条件的技术与做法，并包括负排放解决方案。本文描述了我们系统且可复制的过程，并讨论了其优势、不足以及计划中的未来研究。

title: Agricultural Water Policy During Drought: A Strategy for Including Groundwater Permits in Future Irrigation Buyout Auctions in the Flint River Basin
abstract: Georgia’s Flint River Basin has water management challenges from extensive groundwater pumping for agriculture and in-stream flow requirements. The state has experimented with buying out irrigation permits through auctions. Past auctions were relegated to surface water permits. Recently, the state has allowed groundwater permit holders to participate in future auctions. The Flow-Impact Offer (FIO) developed in this paper provides a way to reconcile the disparate impacts of groundwater and surface water withdrawals on in-stream flows when comparing offers in a buyout auction. The techniques suggested here to operationalize the FIO are applicable to other regions of the world as well.
abstract_zh: 佐治亚州的弗林特河流域面临着水资源管理方面的挑战，主要来自农业领域的大量地下水抽取以及河道内流量的要求。该州曾尝试通过拍卖方式回购灌溉许可。过去的拍卖仅限于地表水许可。最近，该州允许地下水许可持有者参与未来的拍卖。本文提出的“流量影响报价”（FIO）提供了一种方法，用以在比较回购拍卖中的报价时，协调地下水和地表水取水对河道内流量造成的不同影响。本文提出的实现FIO的技术，同样适用于世界其他地区。

title: The groundwater risk index: Development and application in the Middle East and North Africa region
Preferences for Policy Attributes and Willingness to Pay for Water Quality Improvements Under Uncertainty
abstract: When exploring environmental policy options, sometimes neither the current state of the environmental good being analyzed nor the effectiveness of the proposed policy is known with certainty. This is the case with privately owned, residential, onsite wastewater treatment systems (septic systems)—there is ample evidence that they can contribute to water quality impairment, but their contribution is generally stochastic in nature and the efficacy of technological solutions is uncertain. Furthermore, the benefits of ameliorating water quality impairments are public in nature. Septic system owners are legally responsible for maintaining their systems, but requiring them to upgrade otherwise properly functioning tanks is outside the scope of water quality regulations. An incentive structure is necessary to induce private homeowners to invest in septic upgrades that deliver both private benefits in addition to the positive externality for the wider public and environment. The question for policy makers is how these private incentives should be financed, and whether public support can be garnered. Results of a choice experiment in Gwinnett County, Georgia, accounting for both sources of uncertainty—the current state of water quality and the efficacy of the intervention—in the design of water quality policy are presented. We find baseline water quality conditions and policy efficacy significantly affect public support for a policy transferring public funds to private homeowners, in terms of both sentiment and willingness to pay. The manner in which costs are shared across stakeholders also affects the selection of a policy option, but not willingness to pay for it.
abstract_zh: 在探索环境政策选项时，有时既无法确定所分析的环境物品的当前状态，也无法确定拟议政策的有效性。私人拥有的住宅现场污水处理系统（化粪池）即属此类情形：有充分证据表明它们可能导致水质恶化，但其影响通常具有随机性，且技术解决方案的功效也不确定。此外，改善水质恶化问题所带来的效益具有公共性。化粪池的所有者在法律上负有维护其系统的责任，但要求他们升级本来运行正常的化粪池，超出了水质法规的范围。需要一种激励结构，促使私人房主投资于化粪池升级，从而既带来私人收益，也为更广大的公众和环境带来正外部性。政策制定者面临的问题是：这些私人激励应如何筹资，以及能否获得公众支持。本文基于佐治亚州吉温内特县（Gwinnett County）的一项选择实验，在政策设计中同时考虑了两类不确定性——水质的当前状态以及干预措施的功效——并呈现了相关结果。我们发现，基准水质状况和政策功效显著影响公众对于将公共资金转移给私人房主的政策的支持，无论是在态度还是在支付意愿方面。成本在利益相关者之间的分摊方式也会影响政策选项的选择，但不影响对该选项的支付意愿。

title: Valuing Open Space in a Marshland Environment: Development Alternatives for Coastal Georgia
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: In a coastal environment, open space can exist as land set aside by a real estate developer or as tidal marshland. In this article, we determine the relative values of both types of open spaces in a coastal county in Georgia using a spatial hedonic price framework. Results indicate that (1) there is a price premium associated with the marshlands and (2) developers have market incentives to incorporate more open space into their designs of residential subdivisions. Regarding marshlands, we also find that accessibility is an important variable that adds much more value to a property than just the proximity.
abstract_zh: 在沿海环境中，开放空间既可以是房地产开发商预留的土地，也可以是潮汐沼泽地。本文利用空间享乐价格框架，测算了佐治亚州一个沿海县中这两类开放空间的相对价值。结果表明：（1）沼泽地与房产价格溢价相关；（2）开发商有市场激励将更多的开放空间纳入住宅小区的设计之中。就沼泽地而言，我们还发现，可达性是一个重要变量，它为房产带来的价值增益远大于仅仅邻近沼泽地所带来的价值。

title: Green Roof Adoption in Atlanta: The Effects of Building Characteristics and Subsidies on Net Private, Public, and Social Benefits
abstract: This research draws on and expands previous studies that have quantified the costs and benefits associated with conventional roofs versus green roofs. Using parameters from those studies to define alternative scenarios, we estimate from a private, public, and social perspective the costs and benefits of installing and maintaining an extensive green roof in Atlanta, GA. Results indicate net private benefits are a decreasing function of roof size and vary considerably across scenarios. In contrast, net public benefits are highly stable across scenarios, ranging from $32.49 to $32.90 m–2. In addition, we evaluate two alternative subsidy regimes: (i) a general subsidy provided to every building that adopts a green roof and (ii) a targeted subsidy provided only to buildings for which net private benefits are negative but net public benefits are positive. In 6 of the 12 general subsidy scenarios the optimal public policy is not to offer a subsidy; in 5 scenarios the optimal subsidy rate is between $20 and $27 m–2; and in 1 scenario the optimal rate is $5 m–2. The optimal rate with a targeted subsidy is between $20 and $27 m–2 in 11 scenarios and no subsidy is optimal in the twelfth. In most scenarios, a significant portion of net public benefits are generated by buildings for which net private benefits are positive. This suggests a policy focused on information dissemination and technical assistance may be more cost-effective than direct subsidy payments.
abstract_zh: 本研究借鉴并扩展了以往对传统屋顶与绿色屋顶成本和效益进行量化的研究。利用这些研究的参数来设定不同情景，我们从私人、公共和社会三个视角，估算了在佐治亚州亚特兰大市安装和维护一种粗放型绿色屋顶的成本与效益。结果表明，净私人效益是屋顶面积的递减函数，并且在不同情景之间差异很大。相比之下，净公共效益在各情景之间非常稳定，介于每平方米32.49美元至32.90美元之间。此外，我们评估了两种替代补贴方案：（i）向每一座采用绿色屋顶的建筑提供的一般性补贴；以及（ii）仅向净私人效益为负而净公共效益为正的建筑提供的定向补贴。在12种一般性补贴情景中的6种情景下，最优公共政策是不提供补贴；在5种情景下，最优补贴率介于每平方米20至27美元之间；在1种情景下，最优补贴率为每平方米5美元。在定向补贴下，最优补贴率在11种情景中介于每平方米20至27美元之间，而在第十二种情景下则以不提供补贴为最优。在大多数情景中，相当大比例的净公共效益来自那些净私人效益为正的建筑。这表明，相比直接的补贴支付，以信息传播和技术援助为重点的政策可能更具成本效益。

title: The Impacts of Crop Yield and Price Volatility on Producers' Cropping Patterns: A Dynamic Optimal Crop Rotation Model
Using a Climate Index to Measure Crop Yield Response
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Using principal component analysis, a climate index is developed to estimate the linkage between climate and crop yields. The indices based on three climate projections are then applied to forecast future crop yield responses. We identify spatial heterogeneity of crop yield responses to future climate change across a number of U.S. northern and southern states. The results indicate that future hotter/drier weather conditions will likely have significant negative impacts on southern states, whereas only mild impacts are expected in most northern states.
abstract_zh: 本文利用主成分分析构建了一个气候指数，用以估计气候与作物产量之间的联系。随后，基于三种气候预测情景的指数被用于预测未来作物产量的响应。我们识别出在美国北部和南部多个州中，作物产量对未来气候变化响应的空间异质性。结果表明，未来更炎热、更干燥的天气条件很可能对南部各州产生显著的负面影响，而北部大多数州则预计仅受到轻微影响。

title: Assessing the Market for Poultry Litter in Georgia: Are Subsidies Needed to Protect Water Quality?
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Concerns about nutrient loads into our waters have focused attention on poultry litter applications. Like many states with a large poultry industry, Georgia recently designed a subsidy program to facilitate the transportation of poultry litter out of vulnerable watersheds. This paper uses a transportation model to examine the necessity of a poultry litter subsidy to achieve water protection goals in Georgia. We also demonstrate the relationship between diesel and synthetic fertilizer prices and the value of poultry litter. Results suggest that a well-functioning market would be able to remove excess litter from vulnerable watersheds in the absence of a subsidy.
abstract_zh: 人们对水体营养物负荷的担忧，使禽粪施用受到关注。与许多养禽业大州一样，佐治亚州近期设计了一项补贴计划，以促进将禽粪从脆弱流域运出。本文使用运输模型，考察了为实现水源保护目标，是否有必要提供禽粪补贴。我们还展示了柴油和合成化肥价格与禽粪价值之间的关系。结果表明，运作良好的市场能够在没有补贴的情况下，将过剩的禽粪从脆弱流域中移出。

Determinants of Irrigation Farmers' Crop Choice and Acreage Allocation Decisions: Opportunities for Extension Service Delivery
abstract: A survey of Georgia irrigators focused on the determinants of farmers' crop choice and crop acreage allocation decisions was conducted. The survey also addressed farmer interest in open-access information and decision support programs delivered by the University of Georgia via the Internet. Results indicate crop choice and acreage decisions are heavily influenced by rotational considerations, but such considerations are not viewed as strict constraints. Crop futures prices and expected input costs are also important factors. Farmers expressed considerable interest in accessing information relevant to their crop choice and acreage allocation decision on the Internet at a university-run Web site.
abstract_zh: 我们对佐治亚州的灌溉农户进行了一项调查，重点考察农户作物选择与种植面积分配决策的决定因素。该调查还涉及农户对佐治亚大学通过互联网提供的开放获取信息与决策支持项目的兴趣。结果表明，作物选择和种植面积决策受轮作因素的强烈影响，但这些因素并不被视为严格的约束。作物期货价格和预期投入成本同样是重要因素。农户对于在一个由大学运营的网站上获取与其作物选择和种植面积分配决策相关的信息表现出相当大的兴趣。

title: Impacts of Adjusting Environmental Regulations with Diffuse Enforcement Authority: Confined Animal Feeding Operations and Environmental Quality
Regulatory Responses to Potential Pollutants from Animal Feeding Operations: Opting Out of Costly Permitting Regulations
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Because of excessive water impairment, federal and state agencies have enacted regulations to reduce water pollution from animal feeding operations. Many of the regulations are based on numbers of animals rather than the potential of an operator to impair water quality. To enhance efficiency, critical production indicators and location screening factors might be used to exempt operations that are not significantly impairing water quality. In this manner, regulations could avoid imposing unnecessary costs on the regulated public and more effectively target monitoring and enforcement resources of the regulatory agency.
abstract_zh: 由于水体受损严重，联邦和州政府机构已颁布法规，以减少畜禽养殖场造成的水体污染。许多法规是基于养殖动物的数量，而非经营者损害水质的潜力而制定的。为提高效率，可以利用关键的生产指标和区位筛选因素，豁免那些不会对水质造成显著损害的养殖场。如此一来，法规便可避免给受规管公众施加不必要的成本，并能更有效地将监测与执法资源用于真正需要的对象。

title: A bio-economic model of long-run Striga control with an application to subsistence farming in Mali
Integrating Long-Run Biological and Economic Considerations into Striga Management Programs
Economic Analysis of Environmental Benefits of Integrated Pest Management
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Public support for integrated pest management (IPM) is derived in part from concerns over food safety and the environment, yet few studies have assessed the economic value of health and environmental benefits of IPM. An approach is suggested for such an assessment and applied to the Virginia peanut IPM program. Effects of IPM on environmental risks posed by pesticides are assessed and society's willingness to pay to reduce those risks is estimated. The annual environmental benefits of the peanut IPM program are estimated at $844,000. The estimates of pesticide risks and willingness to pay can be applied elsewhere in economic assessments of IPM.
abstract_zh: 公众对病虫害综合治理（IPM）的支持部分源于对食品安全和环境的关注，然而很少有研究评估IPM在健康和环境方面效益的经济价值。本文提出了一种此类评估的方法，并将其应用于弗吉尼亚州的花生IPM项目。我们评估了IPM对农药所带来环境风险的影响，并测算了社会为降低这些风险而愿意支付的费用。弗吉尼亚州花生IPM项目的年环境效益估计为844,000美元。这些对农药风险和支付意愿的估计，可以应用于其他地区的IPM经济评估。
